newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X shrs stopped due to TSE problems.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X shrs stopped due to TSE problems.

text.p: Shares in Canadian gold prospector Bre-X Minerals Ltd stopped trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Wednesday, due to technical problems, an exchange spokesman said.
Bre-X's stock was off 0.65 at 3.20 on massive turnover of 11.7 million shares before the stock stopped trading.
"The stock is currently unavailable due to technical problems," said TSE spokesman Jane Wong. She did not know when trading in Bre-X would resume.
Bre-X resumed trading on Wednesday after being halted in Toronto for all but 22 minutes on Tuesday after technical difficulties forced the TSE to shut down trading in the volatile stock.
Bre-X continued to trade on Nasdaq today, where the stock was off 1/8 at 2-3/8 on volume of 6.8 million shares.
Bre-X was also still trading on the Montreal Exchange, down 0.12 to 3.38 on 1.4 million shares.
